blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remote sensing novel view synthesis under sparse observations remains challenging due to insufficient geometric constraints and limited cross-view supervision. Existing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods are prone to overfitting and face challenges of depth ambiguities, missing cross-view information, and insufficient constraints in under-observed regions. To address these challenges, we propose DIBR-GS, a neural Gaussian Splatting framework that exploits Depth Image-Based Rendering (DIBR) to generate pseudo views for cross-view consistency supervision. Specifically, reliable geometric initialization is constructed by aligning monocular depth priors with sparse SfM reconstruction, and cross-view appearance priors are incorporated into neural Gaussian representations to enhance appearance modeling under sparse observations. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive DIBR-based pseudo-view supervision strategy to provide additional geometric and appearance constraints, enabling more complete reconstruction of weakly observed regions. In addition, a height-constrained anchor growth strategy is designed to suppress unreasonable Gaussian expansion. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance over existing approaches when training with only 3 input views. Compared with the previous best-performing method, it improves PSNR by 6.83 dB, with relative gains of 14% in SSIM and 60% in LPIPS, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/kanehub/DIBR-GS
blocks.zh: 由于几何限制不足和交叉视图监督有限,遥感新视角在稀少观测下合成仍然具有挑战性。 现有的神经辐射场(NERF)和3D高斯电镀(3DGS)方法容易过度适应,并面临深度模糊,截面信息缺失,观测不足的地区制约不足的挑战. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出DIBR-GS,一个利用深度图像渲染(DIBR)生成伪观点的神经高斯电镀框架,用于交叉视图一致性监督. 具体地说,可靠的几何初始化是通过将单元深度前缀与稀疏的SfM重建对齐来构建的,交叉视图的外观前缀被整合到神经高斯表达中,以加强稀疏观测下的外观模型. 此外,我们采用了基于DIBR的渐进式伪观监督战略,以提供额外的几何和外观限制,从而能够更全面地重建观察薄弱的区域。 此外,还设计了高压锚增长策略,以压制高斯大陆不合理的扩张. 实验表明,当培训只有3个投入意见时,拟议方法的绩效优于现有方法。 与之前最优秀的方法相比,它提高了6.83 dB的PSNR,在SSIM和LPIPS的相对增益分别为14%和60%,同时保持了竞争性的计算效率. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/kanehub/DIBR-GS上查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Novel view synthesis aims to render images at arbitrary new viewpoints, given a set of images and their camera poses. In remote sensing, novel view synthesis provides a complementary way to enhance 3D scene understanding beyond conventional observations [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Consequently, it plays a crucial role in applications such as urban 3D reconstruction, disaster assessment, and environmental monitoring [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 小说视图合成旨在以任意的新观点来渲染图像,考虑到一组图像及其相机的姿势. 在遥感中,新视角合成提供了一种补充方式,可增强常规观测以外的三维场景理解[1,2,3,4,5]. 因此,它在城市立体重建、灾害评估和环境监测等应用方面发挥关键作用[6、7、8、9]。

blocks.en: With the rapid development of deep learning, neural rendering has become the mainstream for novel view synthesis [ 10 , 11 ] . Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] employs an implicit neural network to continuously model scene geometry and appearance, performing well in terms of view consistency and detail representation. However, its reliance on dense per-ray sampling incurs high computational costs. Conversely, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] has attracted widespread attention due to its real-time rendering capabilities. By optimizing explicit Gaussian primitives and leveraging tile-based rasterization, it significantly reduces both training and inference overhead while maintaining high-quality rendering results.
blocks.zh: 随着深层学习的迅速发展,神经渲染已经成为小说视野合成[10,11]的主流. 神经辐射场(NERF)[12,13,14,15]使用隐含的神经网络来持续模拟场景几何和外观,在视野一致性和细节表现方面表现良好. 然而,它依赖密集的每张光采样,计算成本很高。 反之,3D高斯电镀(3DGS)[16,17,18,19]因其实时渲染能力而引起广泛关注. 通过优化明显的高斯原始人,利用以瓦片为基础的光栅化,在保持高质量渲染结果的同时,大大减少了训练和推论的间接费用.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, existing neural rendering methods still heavily rely on dense multi-view observations. Under sparse-view conditions, the lack of sufficient multi-view constraints often leads to overfitting. This challenge becomes even more prominent in remote sensing scenes. Due to limitations such as satellite revisit cycles, drone flight paths, and occlusions, it is difficult to capture dense multi-view images. In extreme cases, only 3 to 5 viewpoints are available, which is far fewer than the hundreds of densely sampled multi-view inputs typically used. This observation scarcity leaves large regions of the viewpoint space weakly constrained, resulting in ambiguous geometry, incomplete structures, and inconsistent appearance during novel-view synthesis.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,现有的神经渲染方法仍然在很大程度上依赖于密集的多视图观测. 在零星的视野条件下,缺乏足够的多景限制往往导致过度配色. 这一挑战在遥感场景中变得更加突出。 由于卫星重访周期,无人机飞行路径,以及隐蔽等限制,难以捕捉密集的多视图图像. 在极端情况下,只有3至5个观点,远远少于通常使用的数百个密集抽样的多视图输入。 这种观测的稀缺性使得视野空间的大片区域受到微弱的限制,导致几何学模糊不清,结构不完整,在新视觉合成过程中出现不一致.

blocks.en: For sparse-view inputs, NeRF-based methods typically rely on regularization [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] , semantic priors [ 23 , 24 ] , or depth supervision [ 25 , 26 ] . However, these strategies are mainly developed for object-centric scenes with relatively diverse viewpoint coverage, and their effectiveness remains limited for remote sensing scenes, which contain complex land-cover structures observed from constrained overhead viewpoints. Meanwhile, 3DGS-based approaches attempt to enhance sparse-view performance by incorporating depth priors [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] , co-regularization [ 30 ] , or structural pruning [ 31 ] . Nevertheless, depth ambiguities in remote sensing images can compromise reconstruction accuracy, and heuristic optimization strategies struggle to capture complex scene geometry and maintain cross-view consistency.
blocks.zh: 对于少见的投入,基于NERF的方法一般依赖于正规化[20,21,22],语义学前传[23,24],或深度监督[25,26]. 然而,这些战略主要是针对以物体为中心的场景制定的,其视角覆盖面相对多样,对遥感场景而言,其有效性仍然有限,因为遥感场景包含从有限的俯仰角度观察到的复杂的土地覆盖结构。 同时,基于3DGS的方法试图通过纳入深度前缀[27,28,29],共同规范化[30],或结构穿透[31],来增强稀有的视野性能. 尽管如此,遥感图像中的深度模糊度会损害重建的准确性,而热力优化策略则会挣扎捕捉复杂的场景几何并保持交叉视野的一致性.

blocks.en: To this end, we identify the fundamental challenge of sparse-view novel view synthesis in remote sensing as how to effectively exploit various prior information, including geometry, appearance, and structural relationships, from limited observations. Existing methods are largely constrained by the unreliability and insufficient utilization of such priors, which can be manifested in three aspects. First, geometric priors derived from monocular depth estimation suffer from scale ambiguity and structural distortions in remote sensing images, making them unreliable for accurate supervision or initialization. Second, existing approaches lack effective mechanisms to jointly exploit appearance and geometric cues across multiple views, leading to inconsistent reconstruction of scene structures and textures. Third, the lack of effective supervision for unobserved regions, where observations are limited due to occlusions or viewpoint constraints, often leads to incomplete geometry recovery and degraded reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们确定遥感中零星的新观点综合的基本挑战,即如何从有限的观测中有效地利用各种先前的信息,包括几何、外观和结构关系。 现有方法在很大程度上受到不可靠和未充分利用这些前科的限制,这可表现在三个方面。 首先,单体深度估计得出的几何前兆在遥感图像中存在尺度模糊和结构扭曲,使其不可靠,无法进行准确的监管或初始化。 第二,现有办法缺乏有效机制,无法共同利用各种观点的外观和几何提示,导致场景结构和纹理的重建不一致。 第三,对未观测到的地区缺乏有效的监督,这些地区的观测因被隔离或观点限制而受到限制,往往导致几何复原不完整,重建质量下降。

blocks.en: To address the above challenges, we propose DIBR-GS, a geometry-guided neural Gaussian splatting framework. It enhances sparse-view novel view synthesis in remote sensing scenes by unifying initialization, feature representation, and unobserved-view constraints within a depth image-based rendering (DIBR) [ 32 ] framework, which effectively exploits cross-view geometric and appearance priors. Specifically, we first design a point cloud initialization strategy tailored for monocular depth estimation. An affine transformation is introduced to alleviate scale ambiguity of monocular depth, while multi-view fusion is employed to reduce geometric misalignment and obtain reliable initial anchors. Then, following the image-based rendering (IBR) [ 33 ] framework, cross-view geometric and appearance features are incorporated into the feature representation of neural Gaussians, improving the utilization of limited prior information. More importantly, we introduce a progressive pseudo-view synthesis strategy via DIBR to propagate depth priors from input images to unobserved viewpoints, which effectively promotes multi-view consistency during Gaussian optimization. To further improve robustness for near-nadir remote sensing scenes, we incorporate a height-constrained anchor growth strategy based on aerial scene priors to suppress floating artifacts.
blocks.zh: 为了应对上述挑战,我们提出DIBR-GS,一个几何导电神经高斯电镀框架. 它通过在基于深度图像渲染(DIBR)[32]框架内统一初始化、特征表现和未观测到的视觉限制,加强了遥感场景中零星的视觉新视角合成,有效地利用了交叉视图几何和外观前身。 具体地说,我们首先设计了一个点云初始化策略,专门用来进行单极深度估计. 采用了affine转化法来缓解单子深度的尺度模糊,而多视聚变则用于减少几何错位,并获得可靠的初始锚. 然后,在基于图像的渲染(IBR)[33]框架之后,交叉视图几何和外观特征被纳入神经高斯人特征代表中,改进了有限的前期信息的利用. 更重要的是,我们通过DIBR引入一个进步的伪视图合成策略,将输入图像的深度前言传播到不可观察的观点,这有效促进了高斯优化期间的多视图一致性. 为了进一步提高近纳迪尔遥感场景的稳健性,我们采用了基于空中场景前期的高度约束锚生长策略,以压制漂浮文物.

blocks.en: Ultimately, our proposed method achieves high-fidelity novel view synthesis from sparse-view inputs in remote sensing scenes while preserving real-time rendering capability. Fig. 1 presents the visual and quantitative comparison results.
blocks.zh: 归根结底,我们提出的方法在保留实时渲染能力的同时,从遥感场景中的稀有视图投入中实现了高真实度的新观点合成。 图1介绍了视觉和定量比较结果。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: 1) We propose DIBR-GS, which integrates depth-based image rendering with Gaussian Splatting to effectively exploit geometric and appearance priors for remote sensing sparse view synthesis. 2) We introduce a progressive pseudo view synthesis strategy that propagates depth priors from observed views to unobserved viewpoints, providing additional multi-view consistency constraints during Gaussian optimization. This strategy effectively alleviates incomplete geometry and structural degradation in under-observed regions. 3) Experiments on the LEVIR-NVS [ 1 ] dataset demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches for remote sensing sparse view synthesis, achieving a favorable balance between novel-view rendering quality and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 1)我们提出DIBR-GS,将深度图像渲染与高斯镀层相结合,以有效地利用几何学和外观前身进行遥感稀释视图合成. 2)我们采用进步的伪观点综合策略,将观察观点的深度前导传播到未观察的观点,在高斯优化期间提供额外的多观点一致性限制. 这项战略有效地缓解了观测不足地区的不完全几何和结构退化。 3) LEVIR-NVS [1]数据集的实验表明,拟议的方法一贯优于遥感短视合成的最新方法,在新视角渲染质量和计算效率之间取得有利的平衡。

blocks.en: We propose DIBR-GS, which integrates depth-based image rendering with Gaussian Splatting to effectively exploit geometric and appearance priors for remote sensing sparse view synthesis.
blocks.zh: 我们提出DIBR-GS,它将深度图像渲染与高斯镀层相结合,以有效地利用几何和外观前兆来进行遥感稀疏视图合成.

blocks.en: We introduce a progressive pseudo view synthesis strategy that propagates depth priors from observed views to unobserved viewpoints, providing additional multi-view consistency constraints during Gaussian optimization. This strategy effectively alleviates incomplete geometry and structural degradation in under-observed regions.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一种进步的伪观点综合策略,将观察观点的深度前导传播到未观察的观点,在高斯优化期间提供额外的多观点一致性限制. 这项战略有效地缓解了观测不足地区的不完全几何和结构退化。

blocks.en: Experiments on the LEVIR-NVS [ 1 ] dataset demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches for remote sensing sparse view synthesis, achieving a favorable balance between novel-view rendering quality and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 对LEVIR-NVS [1]数据集的实验表明,拟议的方法一贯优于遥感稀有视野合成的最新方法,在新视角渲染质量和计算效率之间取得有利的平衡。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Neural Scene Representations
blocks.zh: II-A 神经场景表现

blocks.en: Neural scene representation refers to using neural networks to approximate the surface or volumetric representation function, and integrating classical rendering principles to achieve a continuous and compact 3D representation. Based on the underlying structural form, these methods can be categorized into implicit, explicit, and hybrid representations [ 11 ] . Neural Radiance Fields [ 12 , 34 ] serves as a classical implicit approach, which maps spatial coordinates to color and volume density via a multilayer perceptron, enabling high-fidelity novel view synthesis. However, the training efficiency is limited due to the dense sampling and per-ray inference. Hybrid representations [ 35 , 36 , 37 ] incorporate explicit geometry to reduce computational costs, while maintaining modeling capabilities through lightweight decoding networks. Plenoxels [ 36 ] store spherical harmonic coefficients and volume density within a sparse voxel grid to enable efficient queries. Point-NeRF [ 38 ] embeds neural features within point clouds, which accelerates convergence and provides explicit editing capabilities. Alternative methods encode scene information using multi-plane images [ 39 , 40 ] or triplane representations [ 41 ] to avoid the redundancy associated with volumetric approaches.
blocks.zh: 神经场景表现法是指利用神经网络来近似表面或体积表现功能,整合古典渲染原理来实现连续和紧凑的3D表现. 根据基本的结构形式,这些方法可分为隐含的、明确的和混合的表述[11]。 神经辐射场[12,34]是一种古典的隐含方法,它通过多层透视仪将空间坐标映射到色彩和体积密度上,使得高纯度小说视图合成成为可能. 然而,由于采样密集和每道光线推断,培训效率有限。 混合表示 [35,36,37] 包含了明确的几何方法,以减少计算成本,同时通过轻量级解码网络保持建模能力. Plenoxels [36] 将球形的谐波系数和体积密度存储在一个稀疏的voxel网格内,以允许高效的查询. Point-NERF[38]将神经特征嵌入点云中,加速了趋同,提供了明确的编辑能力. 替代方法使用多飞机图像[39,40]或tribele表示法编码场景信息[41],以避免与量子方法相关的冗余.

blocks.en: Recently, explicit representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 16 ] represent scenes with anisotropic Gaussian primitives and rasterization, achieving high-fidelity reconstruction and real-time rendering. 2DGS [ 17 ] introduces surface Gaussian primitives and constrains them to align closely with object surfaces to improve geometric accuracy. Scaffold-GS [ 42 ] introduces an anchor-based hierarchical structure that dynamically generates and organizes neural Gaussians utilizing a sparse voxel grid, addressing issues of structural redundancy and loose organization. Although these approaches resolve the trade-offs among rendering speed, geometric quality, and storage efficiency, the training process still requires massive amounts of multi-view images to ensure convergence.
blocks.zh: 最近,3D Gaussian Splating [16] 等明确表述代表场景有异构的Gaussian原始和光栅化,实现了高真性重建以及实时渲染. 2DGS [17]引入表面高斯原始,并限制它们与物体表面紧密对齐,以提高几何精度. Scaffold-GS [42]引入了基于锚的等级结构,动态生成和组织神经高斯人,使用稀疏的阴道网格,解决结构冗余和松散的组织问题. 虽然这些方法解决了渲染速度、几何质量和存储效率之间的权衡,但培训过程仍然需要大量的多视图图像,以确保趋同。

blocks.en: II-B Novel View Synthesis with Sparse Views
blocks.zh: II- B 带有 Sparse 视图的小说视图合成

blocks.en: Novel view synthesis aims to render images from unobserved viewpoints based on input images and their corresponding poses. Traditional methods require hundreds of views to provide dense supervision, which is impractical for remote sensing scenarios because data acquisition is often constrained by flight path or fuel and collected images are typically sparse. Current research primarily improves sparse-view performance on object-level and synthetic scenes. Early methods introduce regularization constraints to mitigate overfitting in neural radiance fields under sparse views [ 21 , 23 , 20 , 22 ] . For instance, RegNeRF [ 20 ] employs local depth smoothness to eliminate irregular artifacts. DietNeRF [ 23 ] enforces cross-view semantic consistency. FreeNeRF [ 21 ] designs a frequency regularization strategy to achieve progressive learning from low to high frequencies. DS-NeRF [ 25 ] utilizes sparse point clouds as depth supervision, providing effective explicit constraints for scene geometry. Other approaches [ 43 , 44 , 33 ] explore cross-scene pretraining strategies to learn general scene representations and view synthesis priors from large-scale data, enhancing few-shot performance and generalization.
blocks.zh: 小说视图合成旨在根据输入图像及其对应的姿势,从未观察角度渲染图像. 传统方法需要上百种观点才能提供密集的监督,这对遥感情景是不切实际的,因为数据获取往往受到飞行路径或燃料的限制,收集的图像通常很少。 目前的研究主要改进了对物体级别和合成场景的稀有视野性能. 早期的方法引入了规范化的制约,以减轻在低视线下神经辐射场的过度适应[21,23,20,22]. 例如,RegNERF[20]采用局部深度光滑来消除不规则的文物。 DieCNERF [23] 执行交叉视图语义一致性. FreeNERF[21]设计了一个频率规范化战略,以实现从低频率到高频率的渐进学习. DS-NERF[25]利用稀疏点云作为深度监督,为场景几何提供了有效的明确限制. 其他方法[43,44,33]探索跨场前训练策略,从大规模数据中学习一般场景表现和查看合成前身,增强少拍性能和概括性.

blocks.en: 3DGS also suffers performance degradation under sparse viewpoints. To address this, some methods incorporate depth priors as auxiliary supervision [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] . FSGS [ 27 ] guides the initialization and densification of Gaussian primitives using monocular depth. By distributing Gaussian points more appropriately in space, FSGS compensates for holes in sparse initial SfM point clouds, enabling coherent scene reconstruction even with very few samples. Similarly, DNGaussian [ 28 ] employs hard and soft depth regularization losses to enforce consistency between predicted depth and monocular depth, resolving common depth ambiguities under sparse views. Other methods focus on regularization strategies to suppress artifacts and optimize Gaussian distributions [ 31 , 30 , 45 , 46 ] . DropGaussian [ 31 ] identifies and removes redundant primitives that cause visual artifacts by analyzing cumulative opacity and spatial distribution, resulting in a more compact scene representation. CoR-GS [ 30 ] jointly trains two Gaussian fields and utilizes their inconsistencies to suppress inaccurate reconstructions, improving view synthesis quality. Nevertheless, these methods still face challenges in remote sensing scenarios. Monocular depth exhibits inherent scale ambiguity, making depth constraints unreliable. Moreover, manually designed heuristic constraints struggle to handle the complex structures present in remote sensing scenes.
blocks.zh: 3DGS在少数观点下也出现性能退化. 为了解决这一问题,一些方法将深度前导作为辅助监督[27、28、29]。 FSGS [27] 引导高斯原始人使用单体深度初始化和密度化. 通过在空间中更适当地分配高斯积分,FSGS补偿了稀疏的初始SfM积分云中的洞,即使样本很少,也能够进行连贯的场景重建. 同样,DNGausian [28] 利用硬和软深度规范化损失,强制要求预测深度和单极深度之间保持一致,解决在稀疏观点下常见的深度模糊问题. 其他方法注重规范化策略,抑制文物,优化高斯分布[31,30,45,46]. DropGoussian [31]通过分析累积不透明性和空间分布,识别并移除了引起视觉文物的冗余原始人,从而形成了更为紧凑的场景表现. CoR-GS [30]联合训练两个高斯场,并利用它们的不一致来压制不准确的重建,提高视野合成质量. 然而,这些方法在遥感情景中仍然面临挑战。 单层深度显示出内在的尺度模糊,使得深度限制不可靠. 此外,手动设计的热力限制在处理遥感场景中存在的复杂结构方面挣扎。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of the proposed DIBR-GS framework. The framework consists of a DIBR branch and a neural Gaussian branch. In the DIBR branch, monocular depth priors are aligned with sparse SfM reconstruction through affine transformation and multi-view fusion to construct a reliable geometric initialization. Cross-view appearance features are extracted following the image-based rendering paradigm, and progressive DIBR is further employed to generate pseudo views that provide additional supervision. In the neural Gaussian branch, Gaussian anchors are initialized from the dense point cloud, while the anchor features and cross-view appearance features are adaptively integrated to predict Gaussian attributes. The rendered training views and pseudo views are jointly optimized, enabling more complete and consistent reconstruction under sparse-view remote sensing scenes.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: We propose DIBR-GS, a geometry-guided neural Gaussian framework. Inspired by the DIBR, we explore how to effectively leverage reliable geometric and appearance priors through three key stages: geometry initialization, feature representation, and optimization constraints. The overall framework is illustrated in Fig. 2 . First, monocular depth priors are aligned with SfM points and fused across multiple views to construct reliable initial Gaussian anchors, reducing geometric ambiguity under sparse inputs. Then, cross-view reference features are incorporated into neural Gaussian representations to provide complementary appearance cues for sparse-view optimization. Finally, unlike conventional DIBR that aims at producing visually complete images, we utilize progressive DIBR to establish additional supervision in unobserved regions and viewpoints. The generated pseudo views implicitly incorporate geometric information derived from depth priors and enhance multi-view consistency during optimization. Besides, considering the inherent height distribution prior of remote sensing scenes, we further introduce a height-constrained anchor growth strategy to constrain unreasonable Gaussian expansion.

The proposed representation exploits complementary appearance cues from multiple observations following an image-based rendering paradigm. However, due to occlusions and inaccurate matches in sparse views, reference features may contain unreliable information. Therefore, we further introduce an adaptive modulation mechanism to control the contribution of cross-view features during Gaussian optimization.

blocks.en: III-D Height-constrained Anchor Growth
blocks.zh: III-D 高度受制约的锁定器生长

blocks.en: A typical failure mode in sparse-view novel view synthesis is the emergence of floating artifacts around cameras, which mainly originate from regions with insufficient observation constraints [ 21 ] . Due to the limited multi-view overlap, Gaussian optimization may explain uncertain regions by increasing primitive density near the observed viewpoints, resulting in unstable geometry and noticeable artifacts. Although depth-based regularization strategies [ 27 , 28 ] have been explored to alleviate this issue, they usually require reliable depth supervision. In this work, we exploit the inherent characteristics of remote sensing scenes and introduce a lightweight geometry-aware regularization strategy to constrain unreasonable anchor growth.
blocks.zh: 稀有视野小说景观合成中的一种典型的失败模式是出现于相机周围的漂浮文物,这些文物主要来源于观测限制不足的区域[21]. 由于多景重叠有限,高斯优化可能通过在观测到的视线附近增加原始密度来解释不确定的区域,从而导致几何学不稳定和显著的文物. 虽然为缓解这一问题已经探索了基于深度的规范化战略[27,28],但它们通常需要可靠的深度监督. 在这部作品中,我们利用遥感场景的内在特征,引入了轻量级几何感知规范化策略,以制约不合理的锚增长.

blocks.en: During optimization, the model computes the average gradient of neural Gaussians within each local spatial neighborhood, and regions with large gradients are identified as important areas where new anchors are added. Our method specifically aims to identify potential floater Gaussians and prevent wrong anchor growth in these regions. A key characteristic in remote sensing scenarios is that many aerial images are captured from a nadir viewpoint, where a point’s height is negatively correlated with its distance to the camera. This property allows us to detect Gaussians that are anomalously close to the camera based on their height. Therefore, we construct a coarse height map from the initial dense point cloud to identify Gaussians that may cause camera-oriented expansion. Instead of enforcing a strict geometric supervision, the height map serves as a soft criterion to prevent unreasonable anchor growth while preserving valid scene structures. Specifically, we partition the XY plane into grids and estimate a relaxed upper bound on height within each grid, which is used to suppress anchor growth only for Gaussians that clearly fall outside the valid height as shown in Fig. 3 (b). blocks.en: III-E Pseudo View Supervision through Progressive DIBR
blocks.zh: 通过渐进式DIBR进行Pseudo视图监督

blocks.en: Another critical challenge in sparse-view novel view synthesis is the lack of effective supervision for unobserved regions. Due to limited viewpoints and occlusions, some regions in novel views may not be covered by any input observations, resulting in insufficient Gaussian optimization and severe artifacts such as holes or incomplete structures. Prior studies [ 16 , 38 , 51 ] have shown that Gaussians struggle to model areas beyond the boundaries defined by the initial point cloud unless they are explicitly encouraged to expand outward. However, existing methods [ 51 ] cannot precisely identify true boundary regions and may introduce redundant primitives.
blocks.zh: 在零星的新观点综合中,另一个关键挑战是对无人观察的区域缺乏有效的监督。 由于观点和占卜有限,新观点中的一些地区可能不会被任何输入观测所覆盖,导致高斯优化不足,以及孔洞或结构不完整等严重文物. 先前的研究表明[16,38,51],高斯人为了在初始点云定义的边界之外建模区域而挣扎,除非明确鼓励它们向外扩张. 然而,现有方法[51]不能准确确定真正的边界区域,可能引入冗余原始.

blocks.en: To address this issue, we propose to synthesize pseudo views through progressive DIBR to incorporate more prior knowledge from pretrained model. The synthesized pseudo views provide complementary supervision signals, encouraging Gaussian optimization to recover missing structures while maintaining multi-view consistency.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们建议通过渐进式的DIBR综合伪观点,以吸收预先训练过的模型中更多的先天知识. 合成的伪观点提供了互补的监督信号,鼓励高斯优化以恢复缺失的结构,同时保持多视图的一致性.

blocks.en: III-F Optimization
blocks.zh: 三-F 优化

blocks.en: We adopt an end-to-end optimization strategy that jointly trains the neural Gaussian representation and its associated modules. The overall objective is formulated as a pixel-wise reconstruction loss. During training, we jointly optimize three groups of parameters: (i) the learnable attributes of anchor Gaussians, (ii) the neural Gaussian decoder MLP, and (iii) the projection and fusion networks for IBR features. Besides, we adopt a scheduled supervision strategy. During the early training stage, only ground truth images guide the model to reconstruct the global scene structure and establish stable geometry and appearance. Then pseudo-view supervision is introduced periodically to enforce multi-view consistency and eliminate holes. Finally, pseudo-view supervision is disabled to focus on optimizing fine-grained details.
blocks.zh: 我们采用端到端优化策略,联合训练神经高斯代表及其相关模块. 总体目标是按像素判断的重建损失。 在训练期间,我们联合优化了三组参数:(一)锚地高斯的可学习属性,(二)神经高斯解码器MLP,(三)IBR特性的投影和聚变网络. 此外,我们采取了一项预定的监督战略。 在早期训练阶段,只有地面真象指导模型重建全球场景结构,建立稳定的几何和外观. 然后定期引入伪景监督,以强制实施多景一致性并消除漏洞. 最后,伪景监督被禁用,以集中力量优化精细细节.

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on LEVIR-NVS [ 1 ] , a public remote sensing NVS dataset. It comprises 16 scenes derived from Google Earth, simulating aerial imaging viewpoints and covering diverse land-cover types, including mountainous terrain, urban areas, villages, and building complexes. Each scene contains 21 multi-view images at a resolution of 512 × \times 512. To evaluate performance under sparse-view settings, we adopt the data split protocol of TriDF [ 52 ] , uniformly selecting 3 images per scene for training and using the remaining views for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们在LEVIR-NVS[1]上评价我们的方法,这是一个公共遥感NVS数据集. 它由来自Google Earth的16个场景组成,模拟了航空成像视角,覆盖了包括山区地形、城市地区、村庄和建筑群在内的各种土地覆盖类型。 每个场景包含21个多视图图像,分辨率为512×\times 512. 为了在稀少的视图设置下评价性能,我们采用TriDF[52]的数据分割协议,统一选择每个场景3张图像进行培训,并利用其余的视图进行评价.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Baseline and Metrics
blocks.zh: 基线和计量

blocks.en: We compare our proposed method with state-of-the-art approaches, including NeRF-based methods such as RegNeRF [ 20 ] and FreeNeRF [ 21 ] , as well as 3DGS–based methods including FSGS [ 27 ] , DropGaussian [ 31 ] , CoR-GS [ 30 ] and the vanilla 3DGS [ 16 ] . In addition, we compare against advanced methods specifically designed for remote sensing scenarios, including MPNeRF [ 4 ] and TriDF [ 52 ] . For all compared methods, we follow the same experimental settings and training protocols to ensure a fair comparison. Following prior work, we report PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and AVGE metric [ 20 ] to evaluate the rendering quality.
blocks.zh: 我们把我们建议的方法与最新方法进行比较,包括基于NERF的方法,如RegNeRF [20]和FreeNeRF [21],以及基于FSGS [27],DropGoussian [31],CoR-GS [30]和香草3DGS [16] 的基于3DGS的方法. 此外,我们比较了专门为遥感情景设计的先进方法,包括MPNERF[4]和TriDF[52]。 对于所有比较的方法,我们遵循相同的实验设置和培训规程,以确保公平的比较. 继先前的工作之后,我们报告PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS和AVGE 度量衡[20],以评估渲染质量.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Architecture Details

blocks.en: We use the frozen Depth Anything-v2 [ 53 ] model to extract monocular depth maps from the training images, and then invert the disparity to obtain depth. Next, we perform affine transformation using the sparse point clouds estimated by COLMAP [ 54 ] to obtain dense depth maps with real-world scale. To eliminate overlapping regions in the point cloud, we reproject image pixels into 3D space in the world coordinate system and uniformly partition the XY plane into grids, where we compute the height distribution of the point cloud within each grid. When the significance level of the dip test is below 0.05, we consider the grid to contain overlap. The horizontal and vertical distance thresholds ε x ​ y \varepsilon_{xy} and ε z \varepsilon_{z} for redundant point pairs are set to 0.1 and 1.0, respectively. After obtaining the non-overlapping dense point cloud, we perform voxel downsampling with a voxel size of 1.0, and then merge it with the point cloud acquired via SfM for the initialization of neural Gaussians.
blocks.zh: 我们用冰冻的深度 Anything-v2 [53] 模型从训练图像中提取单极深度图,然后反转差异以获得深度. 接下来,我们利用COLMAP估计的稀疏点云来进行芳香转化,以获得具有现实世界尺度的密集深度图. 为了消除点云中的重叠区域,我们把图像像素重新投影到世界坐标系统中的3D空间,并统一将XY平面分割成网格,在这里计算每个网格内点云的高度分布. 当涂料试验的意义水平低于0.05时,我们认为网格可以控制重叠. 冗余点对的横向和纵向距离阈值分别为Xx y\varepsilon_{xy}和 z\varepsilon_{z}分别设定为0.1和1.0. 在获得非重叠密度点云后,我们用1.0的阴道尺寸进行阴道下采样,然后与通过SfM获得的点云合并,以初始化神经高斯人.

blocks.en: To extract reference features, we employ frozen ResNet-50 [ 55 ] and ViT-B/8 vision transformer [ 56 ] , both pretrained with a DINO [ 50 ] objective. The output of ViT includes both global and local tokens, which are projected into the same feature space using linear layers. To ensure consistency with the size of the ResNet feature maps, these tokens are replicated spatially. blocks.en:
The quantitative results on the LEVIR-NVS dataset are reported in Table I . Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves superior reconstruction quality over all competing approaches, encompassing both advanced remote-sensing methods and sparse-view 3DGS-based methods.
We also report the per-scene experimental results, as shown in Table II . These results demonstrate that our approach delivers consistently stable, high-quality rendering across scenes of different types and complexities.
blocks.zh:
LEVIR-NVS数据集的定量结果见表一。 实验结果表明,我们的方法比所有相互竞争的方法都具有更高的重建质量,既包括先进的遥感方法,也包括以3DGS为基础的稀有观点方法。
我们还报告每一地点的实验结果,见表二。 这些结果表明,我们的方法在各种类型和复杂性的场景之间提供一贯的稳定和高质量的渲染。

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 presents visual comparisons on several representative scenes. Due to the inherent complexity of remote sensing scenes and the extremely sparse input views, existing methods often suffer from incomplete structures, blurred boundaries, and inconsistent details. While TriDF preserves the overall scene structure, it still suffers from blurred textures and insufficient detail recovery in local regions. FSGS can reconstruct coarse geometric structures but shows noticeable artifacts such as ghosting and shape distortion in challenging areas. CoR-GS and DropGaussian alleviate certain artifacts but still exhibit issues including blurred edges and missing details. In contrast, the proposed method consistently produces sharper structures and recovers more textural details across all scenes.
This improvement benefits from the unified exploitation of geometric and appearance priors. The geometry-aware initialization with dense depth provides more stable anchors for Gaussian optimization, while cross-view IBR features complement scene representation under limited observations. More importantly, the progressive DIBR-based supervision introduces additional geometric and appearance constraints, enabling the model to recover structures in regions with insufficient observations. As highlighted in the zoomed-in regions, the proposed method maintains more consistent structures and appearance in challenging areas such as image boundaries. Furthermore, it reduces floating artifacts and unreasonable geometric expansion observed in other methods. This demonstrates that the proposed DIBR-based supervision effectively improves multi-view consistency, while the height-constrained anchor growth strategy further stabilizes Gaussian growth. Together, they enhance both structural completeness and rendering stability under sparse-view remote sensing scenes.
blocks.zh:
图4介绍了几个代表性场景的视觉对比. 由于遥感场景固有的复杂性和极少数的输入观点,现有方法往往受到结构不全,界限模糊,细节不一致的影响. 虽然TriDF保留了整体的场景结构,但它仍然受到模糊的纹理以及局部地区细节恢复不足的影响. FSGS可以重建粗糙的几何结构,但在具有挑战性的地区显示出显着的文物如鬼魂和形状扭曲. COR-GS和DropGausian缓解了某些文物,但仍然展出包括模糊的边缘和缺失的细节在内的问题. 与此相反,拟议方法始终如一地产生更尖锐的结构,并恢复所有场景中更多的纹理细节.
这种改进得益于对几何和外观前身的统一利用。 深度密集的几何意识初始化为高斯优化提供了更稳定的锚,而交叉视图的IBR特征则在有限观测下补充了场景表现. 更重要的是,基于DBR的渐进式监督引入了额外的几何和外观限制,使模型能够在观测不足的地区恢复结构. 正如放大区域所强调的,拟议方法在图像边界等具有挑战性的领域保持了更加一致的结构和外观。 此外,它还减少了漂浮文物和其他方法观察到的不合理的几何扩张。 这表明,拟议的基于DIBR的监督能够有效地提高多视角的一致性,而高压锚增长战略则进一步稳定了高斯的增长. 它们共同增强结构完整性,使低视遥感场景具有稳定性。

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Ablation of Model Architecture
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 模型建筑的参照

blocks.en: To validate the contribution of each component within the overall framework, we conduct an ablation study on the key modules of our model, with the results reported in Table III and Fig. 5 . Starting from the full model, we individually remove the dense depth initialization, IBR feature fusion, anchor growth with height map constraint, and pseudo-view supervision modules for comparison. Overall, removing any single component leads to varying degrees of performance degradation, demonstrating that these modules play complementary and synergistic roles within the framework. Specifically, removing the dense depth initialization results in noticeable declines in structural consistency and geometric stability, indicating that high-quality initial point clouds are crucial for stable optimization of neural Gaussian under sparse-view settings. Eliminating the IBR feature fusion module degrades texture fidelity and cross-view appearance consistency, suggesting that multi-view feature aggregation effectively compensates for insufficient input observations. The height-constrained anchor growth strategy shows relatively limited influence on quantitative metrics, but it effectively reduces floating artifacts and unreasonable Gaussian expansion, especially in weakly constrained regions. In contrast, removing pseudo-view supervision causes significant performance degradation, particularly in unobserved regions where holes and structural collapse are more likely to occur as shown in Fig. 5 . This confirms that pseudo views provide essential multi-view consistency priors. In conclusion, the proposed modules enhance the model from the perspectives of initialization, anchor growth control, appearance enrichment, and multi-view consistency, jointly enabling stable and high-quality results in sparse-view remote sensing scenarios.
blocks.zh: 为了证实每个组成部分在总体框架内的贡献,我们对模型的主要模块进行了一项扩展研究,结果见表三和图5。 从完整的模型开始,我们单独去除密集的深度初始化,IBR特征聚变,有高度图约束的锚增长,以及用于比较的伪视图监督模块. 总体而言,消除任何单一组成部分都会导致不同程度的业绩退化,表明这些模块在框架内发挥互补和协同作用。 具体来说,消除密集的深度初始化导致结构一致性和几何稳定性明显下降,表明高质量的初始点云对于在稀有视野环境下稳定优化神经高斯琴至关重要. 消除IBR特性聚变模块会降低纹理的忠诚度和交叉视图的外观一致性,建议多视图特性聚合可以有效弥补输入观察不足. 高度受限锚增长策略显示对定量度量的影响力相对有限,但有效地减少了漂浮文物和不合理的高斯扩张,特别是在受弱限制的地区. 与此相反,消除伪景监督导致性能严重退化,特别是在未观测到的地区,如图5所示,在这些地区,漏洞和结构崩溃的可能性更大。 这证实了伪观点提供了基本的多观点一致性前言。 最后,拟议的模块从初始化、锚固生长控制、外观丰富和多视图一致性的角度改进了模型,共同促成在短视遥感情景中取得稳定和高质量的成果。

blocks.en: We evaluate the impact of different initialization strategies on model performance. We assess the quality of the point cloud by measuring the absolute error (MAE and Abs Rel) of the depth map projected from the dense point cloud onto the input views. All depth results are processed using z-buffering. The results are shown in Table IV and Fig. 6 . We compare different mapping strategies, sources of affine transformation, and point cloud refinement strategies. Among them, Neg. and Inv. represent using the negative or reciprocal values of the original disparity for mapping, respectively. SfM and Fused refer to using the original sparse SfM point cloud and the point cloud processed through Patch Match Stereo densification for affine transformation, respectively. Reproject refers to using multi-view maximum depth to alleviate ambiguities, while No ovlp. is our proposed strategy for removing overlapping point clouds. From the experimental results, it is clear that the reciprocal mapping has higher consistency with the original depth distribution. Although Fused point clouds provide more points for scale adjustment, they also introduce more noise. Additionally, it can be observed that monocular depth tends to underestimate the background depth (indicated by the blue areas in the error map), and this issue becomes more pronounced after multi-view z-buffer processing, as it defaults to retaining the closer depth. The Reproject strategy, which retains the farthest depth from the multi-view images, can alleviate this issue; however, it leads to significant distortion in the foreground depth, which tend to overestimate the depth. Our proposed local point cloud overlap removal strategy effectively mitigates this problem without damaging the foreground depth. We also computed the AVGE metric and found a significant positive correlation with the accuracy of the initialized point cloud, further confirming the importance of the initialization.
blocks.zh: 我们评价不同的初始化战略对模型性能的影响。 我们通过测量从密集点云到输入视图预测的深度图的绝对误差(MAE和Abs Rel)来评估点云的质量. 所有深度结果都通过z缓冲处理. 调查结果见表四和图。 6 (中文(简体) ). 我们比较了不同的测绘策略,亲缘转变的来源,以及点云精炼策略. 其中,Neg.和Inv.分别使用原始差异的负值或对等值进行绘图。 SfM和Fused分别指使用原始稀疏的SfM点云和通过Patch Match立体化处理的点云,以进行芳香转化. 重塑项目(Reproject)是指使用多视图最大深度来减轻模糊性,而No ovlp. 我们提出的消除重叠点云的战略。 从实验结果可以明显看出,对等映射与原深度分布的一致性更高. 虽然Fused点云为尺度调整提供了更多的点,但它们也带来了更多的噪音. 此外,可以观察到,单体深度往往低估背景深度(以错误图中的蓝色区域表示),这个问题在多视图 z-缓冲处理后变得更加突出,因为它默认保留更接近深度. 重新预测战略保留了从多视图图像中最远的深度,可以缓解这个问题;然而,它却导致前景深度的重大扭曲,往往高估深度. 我们提议的局部点云重叠清除战略有效地减轻了这个问题,同时又不损害前景深度。 我们还计算了AVGE的度量,发现与初始化点云的准确性有很大的正相关,进一步证实了初始化的重要性.

blocks.en: Dense depth priors provide the model with initial structural information; however, a trade-off must be made between efficiency and performance, as an excessive amount of redundant point clouds inevitably slows down optimization. To this end, we apply voxel grid downsampling to the dense initial point cloud. We evaluate the impact of different downsampling rates on model performance, and record both the number of initial points and the final number of Gaussian anchors to assess redundancy in the initialization. The results are shown in Fig. 7 and Table V , which is conducted on scene Building#1. As the number of initial points increases, both training time and overall model performance improve accordingly. Nevertheless, a clear elbow point emerges in the curve, beyond which the performance gains become much smaller relative to the increased computational cost. In Fig. 7 , the sizes of the blue and yellow concentric circles represent the numbers of initial points and final Gaussian anchors, respectively. It can be observed that when the initialization contains few points, neural Gaussians must grow extensively to capture scene details. Once the number of initial points exceeds 100k, the final number of Gaussians remains nearly unchanged, indicating that the point number has approached saturation. When the number further exceeds 280k, the final number even decreases, revealing substantial redundancy in the initialization. Overall, downsampling the initial dense point cloud is crucial for improving training efficiency and eliminating redundancy without compromising reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 深层前缀为模型提供了初步的结构信息;然而,必须在效率和性能之间作出权衡,因为过多的冗余点云不可避免地减缓优化的速度. 为此,我们将病毒网格下取样到密集的初始点云. 我们评价不同下采样率对模型性能的影响,并记录初始点数和最终高斯锚数,以评估初始化中的冗余. 结果见图7和表五。 随着初始点数的增加,培训时间和整体模型性能都相应改善. 尽管如此,曲线中出现了一个明显的肘点,超过这个肘点,与计算成本的增加相比,性能的增益要小得多. 在图7中,蓝色和黄色同心圆的大小分别代表初始点数和最终高斯锚数. 可以看到,当初始化包含的点数不多时,神经高斯琴必须广泛生长以捕捉场景细节. 一旦初始点数超过100k,最终的高斯人数基本保持不变,表明点数接近饱和. 当数字进一步超过280k时,最终数字甚至会减少,显示出初始化过程中的大量冗余. 总体而言,对最初的密集点云进行下取样,对于提高培训效率和消除冗余而不损害重建质量至关重要。

blocks.en: The size of the anchors reflects the level of granularity used for scene modeling. We evaluate the effect of different anchor sizes on scene Building#1, with the results shown in Fig. 8 and Table VI . With the number of initial points fixed, finer grid resolutions lead to higher reconstruction performance, but at the cost of a larger number of anchors and increased computational overhead.

When the anchor feature dimension is fixed at 32,
increasing the IBR feature dimension from 32 to 256 leads to only minor performance variations. In particular, the best performance is achieved when C r = 32 C_{r}=32 , while further increasing the IBR feature dimension does not yield noticeable improvements. This suggests that in the current task, IBR features primarily serve to supplement cross-view appearance information, which can be sufficiently represented at relatively low dimensionality. Increasing the number of channels beyond this level introduces redundant information without effectively enhancing the representation capability. We further analyze the influence of the anchor feature dimension. The results show that increasing C f C_{f} from 16 to 32 significantly improves model performance, whereas further increasing it to 64 results in only marginal gains. This indicates that, under the complexity of the current scenes, a 32-dimensional feature space is sufficient to effectively encode the key attributes of anchors. Overall, the anchor feature dimension has a more pronounced impact on model performance, while the IBR feature dimension mainly provides auxiliary information. Moreover, we observe that the model tends to achieve better performance when the two feature dimensions are well matched. Considering the trade-off between performance and computational efficiency, we adopt the configuration C f = 32 C_{f}=32 and C r = 32 C_{r}=32 in the final model, which achieves the best overall performance in our experiments.

blocks.en: We further conduct ablation experiments on the network architecture in Table VIII . Removing the modulation network or freezing the feature projection module consistently degrades performance, confirming the importance of adaptive IBR feature integration. Excluding either ResNet or ViT features also leads to performance drops, indicating that local texture cues and global semantic information are complementary for cross-view feature modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步对表八中的网络结构进行消化试验。 取消调制网络或冻结特性投射模块会不断降低性能,确认适应性IBR特性集成的重要性. 排除ResNet或ViT功能也会导致性能下降,表明本地纹理提示和全球语义信息是交叉视图功能模型化的补充.

blocks.en: IV-E Analysis of DIBR-based Pseudo-view Supervision
blocks.zh: IV-E 对基于DBR的Pseudo-view监督的分析

blocks.en: Fig. 9 (a) illustrates the pipeline of the proposed progressive DIBR-based supervision strategy. Given the camera trajectory of the training views, intermediate viewpoints are sampled to construct additional supervision signals. For each target viewpoint, its depth map is obtained from the dense point cloud and used to establish geometric correspondence for depth-based warping. Next, images from multiple source views are projected to the target viewpoint via depth-based warping. The source views are integrated progressively according to their distances to the target viewpoint, since closer views generally provide more reliable correspondences with fewer occlusions. In this way, the visible regions of the target view are gradually filled, while the remaining uncovered regions are completed using a padding strategy, resulting in the final pseudo-view image.
blocks.zh: 图9(a)说明了拟议的基于DBR的渐进监督战略的筹备情况。 鉴于培训观点的摄像轨迹,对中间观点进行取样,以构建更多的监督信号。 对于每个目标角度,它的深度图都是从密度点云中获取的,并用来建立几何对应,用于深度对战. 其次,来自多个源视图的图像将通过深度扭曲投射到目标视角。 信息来源的观点根据它们与目标观点的距离而逐步综合起来,因为更接近的观点通常提供更可靠的函证,而隐含的距离较少。 这样,目标视图的可见区域逐渐被填充,而其余的未发现区域则采用贴补策略完成,从而形成最终的伪视图图像.

blocks.en: Fig. 9 (b) provides an example of the progressive synthesis process. The top row visualizes the coverage of different source views in the target view, where the orange, blue, and green regions represent the projected areas from three source views, and the purple regions denote the padding areas. The bottom row shows the corresponding step-by-step synthesis results. As illustrated, the visible regions contributed by different source views vary significantly in the target view, making it difficult for a single view to fully cover the target image. By progressively integrating projections from multiple views, the observable region can be effectively expanded, gradually establishing a more complete supervision signal. In this example, the target pseudo-view is selected from the test set, and we compute the PSNR between the synthesized pseudo-view and the ground-truth image.
blocks.zh: 图9(b)提供了逐步综合过程的例子。 上行可视化了目标视图中不同源视图的覆盖范围,其中橙色,蓝色,绿色区域代表了来自三个源视图的预测区域,紫色区域代表了粘贴区域. 下行显示相应的分步合成结果. 如前所述,不同来源观点所贡献的可见区域在目标视图中差异很大,使得单一视图难以完全覆盖目标图像. 通过逐步综合多种观点的预测,可以有效地扩大可观测区域,逐步建立更加完整的监督信号. 在这个例子中,目标伪景是从测试集中选择的,我们计算合成伪景和地面真实图像之间的PSNR.

blocks.en: Although the synthesized pseudo-view achieves a relatively low pixel-level fidelity (PSNR = 15.82) due to accumulated depth errors and reprojection inaccuracies, it should be noted that these pseudo views are not expected to provide pixel-perfect targets. Instead, they provide approximate geometric and appearance constraints that complement the sparse original observations. This guidance encourages neural Gaussians to expand into unobserved regions. As a result, the final rendered image produced by the model achieves a PSNR of 27.86. Furthermore, when pseudo-view supervision is removed, the model produces noticeable holes in novel view rendering, as shown in Fig. 5 , indicating that supervision from the original views alone is insufficient to cover all visible regions under sparse-view settings. These results demonstrate that the proposed strategy effectively improves supervision coverage and provides valuable multi-view consistency constraints for sparse-view reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 虽然由于累积的深度误差和重排不准确,合成的伪视图实现了相对较低的像素级忠诚度(PSNR = 15.82),但应当指出,这些伪视图预计不会提供像素完美的目标. 相反,它们提供了近似几何和外观限制,补充了稀少的原始观测。 这种指导鼓励神经高斯人向无人观察的地区扩张. 因此,该模型制作的最终渲染图像达到了27.86的PSNR. 此外,如图5所示,当取消伪视图监督时,该模型在新视图渲染方面产生明显漏洞,表明仅从原始视角进行的监督不足以覆盖在稀有视图环境中的所有可见区域。 这些结果表明,拟议战略有效地扩大了监督范围,并为零星的重建提供了宝贵的多种观点一致性限制。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This paper addresses the challenge of novel view synthesis in remote sensing scenarios under sparse observations. To this end, we propose DIBR-GS, a neural Gaussian framework that exploits Depth Image-Based Rendering (DIBR) as an additional consistency supervision mechanism between observed and unobserved viewpoints. By integrating reliable geometric initialization, cross-view appearance priors, and progressive DIBR-guided optimization, the proposed framework effectively alleviates geometric ambiguity and insufficient supervision caused by sparse inputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIBR-GS consistently improves reconstruction quality, producing more complete structures, sharper appearance details, and fewer artifacts. These results verify the effectiveness of utilizing DIBR-based supervision for enhancing multi-view consistency in sparse-view remote sensing novel view synthesis. The proposed framework provides a promising solution for remote sensing 3D reconstruction and scene understanding when dense observations are unavailable. However, the proposed method still relies on per-scene optimization. Future research will explore more efficient and generalizable novel view synthesis approaches, such as feed-forward methods.
blocks.zh: 本文论述在稀少的观测下遥感情景中新颖观点综合的挑战。 为此,我们提出DIBR-GS,这是一个利用深度图像渲染(DIBR)的神经高斯框架,作为观察和未观察观点之间额外的一致性监督机制. 通过整合可靠的几何初始化,交叉视图的前身,以及渐进的DIBR制导优化,拟议框架有效缓解了由于投入稀少造成的几何模糊和监管不足. 广泛的实验表明,DIBR-GS不断提高重建质量,生产更完整的结构,更清晰的外观细节,以及较少的文物. 这些结果验证了利用基于DIBR的监督在稀有的遥感新观点合成中加强多视图一致性的有效性。 拟议的框架为遥感三维重建和在没有密集观测时的场景理解提供了一个很有希望的解决办法。 然而,拟议方法仍然依赖于每个场景的优化。 未来的研究将探索更有效、更普遍的新型观点综合方法,如饲料推进方法。
